result_text:
I changed `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `DataStore.java` to order open tickets high, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. It uses the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority ...` clause as the sales-rep list, with `t.opened_date, t.id` as the tie-breakers. I also updated the Javadoc to match.

The full `mvn -q -o test` run finished with no output, so it reported no failures. I didn't add a test for the new ordering, and no existing test refers to this method. The only other caller is `RegionManagerService`, which I left alone.
